skill.summary: Adyen BinLookup API skill. Use when working with Adyen BinLookup for get3dsAvailability, getCostEstimate. Covers 2 endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Adyen BinLookup API skill.

- Provides access to Adyen BinLookup API version 54.
- Supports two endpoints: get3dsAvailability and getCostEstimate.
- Requires ADYEN_BINLOOKUP_API_KEY for authentication.
- Includes setup instructions, endpoint details, and response tips.
- Offers CLI commands for updating and searching API specifications.
